title: draw/flow/win share one byte-identical .log.bin stub; audio/health_lose share another
evidence:
index 3d95e02..cf3b36a 100644
Binary files a/goldens/draw.log.bin and b/goldens/draw.log.bin differ
index 3d95e02..cf3b36a 100644
Binary files a/goldens/flow.log.bin and b/goldens/flow.log.bin differ
index 3d95e02..cf3b36a 100644
Binary files a/goldens/win.log.bin and b/goldens/win.log.bin differ
index fb01682..22c8783 100644
Binary files a/goldens/audio.log.bin and b/goldens/audio.log.bin differ
index fb01682..22c8783 100644
Binary files a/goldens/health_lose.log.bin and b/goldens/health_lose.log.bin differ
detail: Identical blob hashes mean identical file content: three unrelated demos share one stub, two others share another. These goldens cannot discriminate per-demo binary output, so a regression in any of those demos passes unnoticed.
recommended_fix: Emit per-demo binary logs, or explicitly mark these as shared empty stubs and exclude them from golden comparison.

title: input_parity .t1 manifests regenerated with no paired .log.bin, unlike other .t1-bearing demos
detail: boot, node_health, and terminal_types each have a .log.bin regenerated or added alongside their .t1, but input_parity_draw and input_parity_draw_wide have only their .t1 updated. If these demos emit binary logs, those goldens are stale after the catalog change.
recommended_fix: Confirm the input_parity demos emit no binary log; if they do, regenerate their .log.bin goldens.
